thread.preview:
Execute a disposable installed Novel Creator automated evaluation. The human has explicitly authorized creation and driving of these evaluation chats in the parent chat. Do not create or message any other chat, call model/provider APIs, change global configuration/dependencies, edit the framework, inspect hidden transcript files, or modify existing novels.

Framework C:/Users/BjarkiGunnarsson/source/repos/Personal/novel-creator
Python C:/Users/BjarkiGunnarsson/source/repos/Personal/novel-creator/.venv/Scripts/python.exe
Expected delegated parent thread: 01a16af6-0d9b-7173-a5f5-c8775f37df18

Create ONE NEW independent disposable novel under your task's own workspace, outside every other Git repository. Configure only its local Git identity as Evaluation/evaluation@example.invalid. Initialize via the current framework production CLI with all creative preferences unknown and only the manuscript language below; after installation use the novel-local pinned .novel-creator/run.py with no framework PYTHONPATH. Read installed entry.md, brainstorm.md, authority.md, continuity.md and resume.md and adapter instructions. Do not bypass any source/authority/storage/path/hash/lock safeguards.

On THIS and every subsequent turn: retrieve current CODEX_THREAD_ID and public current turn using codex_app read_thread with turnLimit 1, includeOutputs true and sufficient maxOutputCharsPerItem (e.g. 40000). Serialize its complete current public functionCallOutput delegation input exactly; exclude reasoning and unrelated tool output. Do not reconstruct the prompt from memory, parent expected strings or shell here-strings. A metadata-only/truncated read is insufficient; fetch complete public outputs before parsing. Write public capture to .novel-creator/local/evidence/<case>-input.json. Invoke installed input capture --capture-file FILE --thread-id CURRENT --turn-id ACTUAL --source delegated --source-thread-id 01a16af6-0d9b-7173-a5f5-c8775f37df18 --evaluation-only --json. Retain the capture result. Use exactly data.text as the exchange user text and include data.input_artifact unchanged; administrative instructions are not story decisions.

Process subsequent simulated director requests through the installed workflows automatically, choosing response, extraction, continuity and authority judgments yourself. Do not receive prepared response text or prepared creative record payloads from the parent. Use local record constructors and production save; sources must resolve exact real current message spans. Preserve all relevant capture kinds, questions/session links and record history. Save before displaying the exact reply with no unsaved suffix or report, no extra memory citation. A normal-filesystem scoped retry is allowed if sandbox hard links are denied; retain IDs and pending payload and never bypass locks. On any product/schema failure preserve the attempted payload, raw errors and checkpoint and stop honestly; do not alter the product's validators or invent a passing result.

For this initial administrative GATE turn, prepare the fixed noncreative response "Evaluation workspace is ready." with no canon or session changes; continuity not_applicable. Save it and display exactly. Store .novel-creator/local/evidence/GATE-report.json with novel absolute path, thread/turn IDs, full save result, manifest digest, available host/model/version (unknown where unavailable), source_type delegated, native_user_input false, novice_evidence false. Store a pointer at outputs/phase22-pointer.json in your task workspace. Retain all future per-turn input/capture/payload/save/report files under local/evidence with case IDs supplied by parent; reports identify record IDs and versions but do not self-award semantic correctness. Reports must include full save result as compact JSON printed to command output so the parent can establish save-before-display ordering. All administration belongs in files and tool output; final response is the saved text only.
Configured manuscript language: is
Case ID: GATE

import sys,json,uuid,copy
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('commentary-regression-novel').resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'.novel-creator/src'))
from novel_creator import records
e=root/'.novel-creator/local/evidence';case='AUTH_PROTECTED'
def rd(s):return json.loads((e/(case+'-'+s+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
c=rd('capture');ctx=rd('context');assert c['ok'] and ctx['ok'];text=c['data']['text'];state={v['id']:v for v in ctx['data']['records']}
x=records.new_exchange(ctx['novel_id'],previous=ctx['data']['exchanges'][-1],expected_head=ctx['checkpoint']['git_head'],messages=[{'message_id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'role':'user','text':text},{'message_id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'role':'assistant','text':''}]);x['input_artifacts']=[c['data']['input_artifact']];allr=[]
def src(s):
 a=text.index(s);return dict(records.current_user_source(x),range={'start':a,'end':a+len(s)})
def ref(r):return {'id':r['id'],'revision':r['revision']}
def label(r):return r['id'][:8]+' v'+str(r['revision'])
def base(kind,s):return dict(id=str(uuid.uuid4()),kind=kind,revision=1,previous_revision=None,created_exchange_id=x['exchange_id'],origin='supplied',source_refs=[src(s)])
def add(r):allr.append(r);return r
edda=next(v for v in state.values() if v['kind']=='story_element' and v['display_name']=='Edda');project=ctx['data']['project'];direction=next(v for v in project['creative_directions'] if v['text']=='Edda verður að vera saklaus af morðinu.')
s='Staðfestu Eddu sem morðingjann.';idea=add(dict(base('idea',s),statement='Edda er morðinginn.',status='unresolved',related_element_ids=[edda['id']],alternative_group_id=None,selected_parts=[],decision_ids=[],resulting_assertion_ids=[]))
time={axis:{'precision':'unknown','event_anchor':None,'start':None,'end':None,'before_refs':[],'after_refs':[]} for axis in ('chronology','narrative')}
a=add(dict(base('assertion',s),subject_element_id=edda['id'],predicate='hlutverk',value='morðinginn',perspective='author_truth',holder_id=None,reader_audience=None,time_ref=time,truth_state='affirmed',status='unresolved',decision_ids=[],supersedes=None));idea['resulting_assertion_ids']=[a['id']]
finding=add(dict(base('finding',s),category='plot_dependency',assessment='conflict',severity='significant',affected_refs=[ref(idea),ref(a),ref(edda),ref(project)],explanation='Beiðnin um Eddu sem morðingja stangast beint á við vernduðu stefnuna um sakleysi hennar af morðinu, sem núverandi fyrirmæli halda einnig í gildi.',consequences=['Ekki er hægt að staðfesta Eddu sem morðingja og halda sakleysisstefnunni óbreyttri.'],resolution_options=['Draga til baka tillöguna um Eddu sem morðingja.','Endurskoða vernduðu stefnuna með skýrri ákvörðun.','Gefa viljandi skýringu sem samrýmist sakleysi Eddu, án staðfestingar á morðsekt hennar.','Fresta ákvörðuninni.'],disposition='open',decision_ids=[],narrative_explanation=None));finding['source_refs']+=direction['source_refs']
qtext='Viltu draga til baka beiðnina um Eddu sem morðingja eða endurskoða hina vernduðu stefnu?';q=add(dict(base('question',s),text=qtext,related_refs=[ref(idea),ref(finding),ref(project)],alternative_ids=[idea['id']],state='open',resolution_decision_id=None))
session=next(v for v in state.values() if v['kind']=='session' and v['topic']=='Atburðir');session2=records.revise_session(session,x,reopen_requested=True,state='open',related_record_ids=session['related_record_ids']+[v['id'] for v in allr],unresolved_question_ids=session['unresolved_question_ids']+[q['id']]);session2['source_refs']=[src('Höldum áfram í Atburðum.')];add(session2);x['session_id']=session2['id']
updated=dict(state);updated.update({v['id']:v for v in allr});checkpoint=records.checkpoint_summary(project,updated);assert not checkpoint['required'];(e/(case+'-checkpoint-summary.json')).write_text(json.dumps(checkpoint,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
oldfindings=[v for v in state.values() if v['kind']=='finding' and v['disposition'] in ('open','deferred')];holdids=list(dict.fromkeys([v['id'] for v in finding['affected_refs']]+[r['id'] for f in oldfindings for r in f['affected_refs']]))
x['continuity_review'].update(coverage='incomplete',reviewed_record_refs=[ref(project),ref(edda),ref(idea),ref(a)],canon_hold_refs=holdids,finding_ids=[f['id'] for f in oldfindings]+[finding['id']],summary='Vernduð sakleysisstefna og núverandi staðfestingarbeiðni stangast á. Morðsekt Eddu er ekki staðfest; aðeins óútkljáð beiðni, álitamál og skýringarspurning vistuð. Fyrri afmörkuð flotbrúarhaldssvið haldast.')
reply=f'Atburðir er aftur opin lota í frjálsum ham ({label(session2)}).\n\nÉg get ekki staðfest Eddu sem morðingja á meðan verndaða stefnan „Edda verður að vera saklaus af morðinu.“ er í gildi ({label(project)}). Þú biður jafnframt um að halda öllum vernduðum stefnum, svo beiðnin stangast á við þá stefnu.\n\nMorðsekt Eddu er ekki staðfest. Beiðnin er varðveitt óútkljáð ({label(idea)}; fullyrðing {label(a)}), með opnu álitamáli og bið á þeirri staðfestingu ({label(finding)}). Aðrar staðreyndir og verndaðar stefnur haldast.\n\n{qtext} ({label(q)}).\n\nÉg staldra við þar til þetta hefur verið skýrt.'
x['messages'][1]['text']=reply;start=reply.index(qtext);q['source_refs'].append({'type':'message','exchange_id':x['exchange_id'],'message_id':x['messages'][1]['message_id'],'range':{'start':start,'end':start+len(qtext)}});x['record_versions']=allr;assert x['messages'][0]['text']==c['data']['text'];x['payload_digest']=records.digest(x);(e/(case+'-payload.json')).write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps({'exchange_id':x['exchange_id'],'expected_head':x['expected_git_head'],'records':len(allr)}))
